title: Payment AP2 Mandate Extension - Agent Nexus overlay
description: A local overlay on https://ucp.dev/schemas/common/payment_ap2_mandate.json (UCP 2026-08-25). UCP's checkout_mandate pattern only admits a JWS followed by tilde-separated segments without dots, so it rejects the AP2 v0.2.0 mandate format UCP itself points to: every AP2 mandate ends with a tilde, and a delegated mandate chains its closing KB-SD-JWT behind '~~'. This overlay accepts either form and leaves everything else to the upstream schema, which stays unchanged. See Documentation/Protocols/KnownSpecConflicts.rst.

ap2_mandate_chain.title: AP2 v0.2.0 mandate
ap2_mandate_chain.description: One SD-JWT or a delegation chain of SD-JWTs as the AP2 v0.2.0 SDK serialises it: <JWT>~<disclosure>~...~ and, per delegation step, ~<KB-SD-JWT>~<disclosure>~...~. Every token ends with a tilde; tokens are joined by the empty component that gives '~~'.

checkout_mandate.title: Checkout Mandate
checkout_mandate.description: ap2.checkout_mandate: the form the upstream pattern describes, or an AP2 v0.2.0 mandate (chain).

ap2_with_checkout_mandate.description: AP2 extension data including checkout mandate, with the overlay's checkout_mandate.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with AP2 Mandate
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: The upstream composition with the overlay's checkout_mandate.
